title: mirandea nutans
intro: Mirandea nutans, commonly known as  Oaxacan gentian, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mirandea nutans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Mirandea nutans also contribute to its use in the treatment of various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin irritation.
